observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Outdoor evening setting, likely a courtyard or street during a celebration or wedding, with seated spectators in the background and a banner mentioning 'Düğün Organizasyonu'.
observation.dancers: Several men dancing in groups or pairs, all male.
observation.formation_and_space: Dancers move in an open space facing each other or dancing independently in an informal cluster, occasionally moving closer to partner up or pass each other.
observation.posture: Upright torso with slight forward lean during deep knee bends and crouches.
observation.footwork: Rhythmic stepping, stamping, and hopping on the beat, featuring high knee lifts and alternating steps.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms held up at shoulder or head height, clicking spoons together rhythmically.
observation.hips_and_torso: Natural movement with occasional bending of the torso forward and side-to-side orientation changes.
observation.partnering: Mostly solo dancing with occasional moments of facing a partner, holding hands briefly, or mirroring movements.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Transitions between standing upright, low squatting/crouching positions, and occasional turns or high kicks.
observation.costume_and_props: Casual attire including light-colored button-down shirts, vests, jeans, and trousers; holding wooden spoons in each hand.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact footwork details below ankle level due to low video resolution and fast movement.
